picks.rationale: Concrete result: structure-first AI search across 214M predicted proteins surfaces unrecognized GPCR-family members and assigns TM184C a function — a new discovery route, not a rehash.
picks.excerpt: Researchers used AI to scan over 214 million predicted proteins by 3D structure rather than sequence, surfacing unrecognized GPCR-family members including TM184C and its role in cell-to-cell bridges.
picks.title: AI helps find hidden human proteins and reveals what they do

picks.rationale: Princeton's PACMAN closes the loop on fusion plasma in milliseconds — a working control system, and the only physics/fusion story in the fresh pool.
picks.excerpt: Princeton researchers tested PACMAN, an AI system that monitors and controls fusion plasma in milliseconds, reacting far faster than a human operator can.
picks.title: AI can now control fusion plasma faster than humans can react

picks.rationale: AI reconstruction turns 27 years and 100+ frames into the sharpest blazar-jet footage ever made — a record-setting observational result, and highly visual.
picks.excerpt: Researchers combined more than 100 images of a single black hole into an AI-reconstructed video charting the activity of a mighty blazar jet.
picks.title: See the highest-resolution footage of a black hole jet ever taken, thanks to AI and 27 years of observations

picks.rationale: A measured 86.1% cut in quantum resource estimates from 100+ scientists working alongside coding agents — rare hard evidence of agents doing real research optimization.
picks.excerpt: An open project pairing 100+ human scientists with AI coding agents cut the estimated quantum resources for elliptic-curve point addition by 86.1%, a rare demonstration of agents doing real research optimization.
picks.title: Researchers and AI agents cut estimated quantum cost of attacking Bitcoin encryption by 86%

picks.rationale: AI reading 400,000 Reddit posts as a pharmacovigilance signal found GLP-1 side effects trials missed — a new evidence source for drug safety, freshest item in the pool.
picks.excerpt: AI analysis of 400,000 Reddit posts found that users of GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound reported unexpected symptoms that clinical trials had missed.
picks.title: AI uncovers hidden Ozempic side effects across 400,000 Reddit posts
